stories.title: Define prescription behavior UI data contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data schema for prescription behavior display including relevance indicator, top drugs list, integrity flag (clean/flagged), and score contribution. Ensure compatibility with backend outputs from EVAL-P-RX and ingestion pipeline.
stories.evidence: design/design_eval_p_rx_drug_mapping + GAP: frontend contract not yet defined for MessageBubble rendering

stories.title: Implement prescription behavior transformation logic
stories.description: Build frontend logic to transform raw prescription behavior data into display-ready structures including ranking top relevant drugs, computing relevance indicator, and mapping integrity flags to UI states.
stories.evidence: design/design_eval_p_rx_drug_mapping supports drug relevance logic; GAP: no existing transformation layer in frontend

stories.title: Render prescription behavior in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble.tsx to render prescription behavior module inside provider scorecard including visual indicators for relevance, integrity (clean/flagged), top drugs, and contribution to overall score.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx is the rendering pipeline; GAP: no prescription UI component exists

stories.title: Integrate prescription behavior API response into chat flow
stories.description: Wire backend prescription behavior data into the chat response payload and ensure frontend correctly detects and renders the module within provider evaluation responses.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py orchestrates provider evaluation responses; GAP: no RX-specific payload integration

stories.title: End-to-end and component tests for prescription behavior display
stories.description: Create unit tests for transformation logic and component rendering, plus end-to-end test validating that prescription behavior appears correctly in chat with real pipeline data.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend and backend test structure + Code/DataPipelines/tests for pipeline validation; GAP: no RX UI test coverage exists
